overall_goal: Fill the tart cases with raspberry and lemon curd

goals.description: Poke holes in the tart cases
goals.rationale: The person pokes holes in the tart cases so the curd has a place to pool.

goals.description: Move the muffin tray and adjust a tart case
goals.rationale: The person moves the muffin tray next to the mixing bowl and fixes one of the tart cases.

goals.description: Fill the first half of the tart cases in the tray with curd
goals.rationale: The person scoops raspberry and lemon curd and transfers it into the first several tart cases.

goals.description: Fill the remaining tart cases in the first tray with curd
goals.rationale: The person continues to scoop and transfer the curd mixture into the rest of the tart cases in the tray.

goals.description: Top up the partially filled tart cases with more curd
goals.rationale: The person adds extra curd to the tart cases that were not fully filled.

goals.description: Swap the filled muffin tray with a new one
goals.rationale: The person moves the completed tray away and brings a new muffin tray from the hob to be filled.

goals.description: Fill the second tray of tart cases with curd
goals.rationale: The person scoops and transfers the curd mixture into the tart cases of the second tray.
